demo_notice: Illustrative example of an evidence record. Not evidence and not a measurement of any market.

_reading_notes.why_provenance_is_the_headline_field: A synthetic fixture and a real capture can carry identical numbers. Only provenance distinguishes them, and only one of the two can support a conclusion about a market. The Control Center renders this per row rather than as a page-level note, because a page can contain both.
_reading_notes.why_is_real_observation_is_computed: It is derived from the provenance class rather than being an independent field, so it cannot disagree with it.
_reading_notes.lineage: alpha source -> experiment -> artifact. The chain is what makes a conclusion traceable back to the thing that produced it, and it is what the Evidence Explorer renders.
